title: Regularity of a Geodesic equation in the space of mixed Volume Forms on Hermitian Manifolds
summary: We prove regularity of a fully nonlinear equation that arises from the study of geodesics in the space of mixed volume forms on Hermitian manifolds admitting a balanced metric. Under conditions for ellipticity, we prove that this degenerate equation has a $C^{1,1}$ solution on Hermitian manifolds. We derive uniform Laplacian estimates for the perturbed equation, and also construct explicit subsolutions. In particular, this shows the existence of a unique $C^{1,1}$ solution to the Donaldson equation on Hermitian manifolds.
